_doc: Task config interfacing the SpatialWorld 3D games to the general meta-harness (AutoSpatial/harness_map). The 5 games are scored PER GAME and reported RESPECTIVELY: game_adapter.evaluate() runs harness/run_benchmark.py once and returns {game -> Fitness}, one Fitness per game (its own score / episodes / instance count). Nothing is blended into a single aggregate number.

scoring._doc: One aggregate score across 105 instances. 4 games use their binary success verifier; snake uses the paper-aligned scale-normalized discrete score min(score / L, 1), L = spatial edge length of the 4x4x4 grid. Overall = task-count-weighted mean of the 5 family scores.

fitness._doc: Per game: primary = that game's score (binary success rate for maze/block3d/maze3d_pro/rubik; scale-normalized mean min(score/L,1) for snake). The adapter builds one Fitness per game directly from results_summary.csv — reported respectively.

selection._doc: Selection is per game on that game's own score.

meta_agent._doc: Backbone for the proposer/judge/diagnostician (the meta-agent that edits the rich harness). cli:claude = shell out to the Claude Code CLI (native file/shell tools + skills). Overridable at runtime via META_BACKBONE (claude|openai|codex). model/base_url are ignored for cli backbones (the CLI owns its model). iris/dgm use this via adapter.propose; gepa uses its own ClaudeCodeAgentProposer (--gepa-proposer claude-code); shinka uses headless/claude; openevolve has no claude path and runs on OPENAI_META_MODEL (disclosed).
